testimony.subject: Fee patent received in 1918, land ownership and sale status
testimony.key_claims: Alphonse Charbonneau confirmed he is a Rosebud Sioux allottee who applied for and received a fee patent mailed to him at Valentine in 1918. He signed a receipt for it and accepted it without protest. He states he still owns the land but also notes NW 15 was sold for $2000 cash. He is in good health, has no dependents, and supports himself through farming.
